summary: The implementation successfully addresses all six requirements with comprehensive frontend and backend changes. Live search, custom prop firm addition, localStorage caching, merged firm lists, improved dropdown scrolling, and account submission fixes are all implemented. The solution includes proper error handling, validation, duplicate prevention, and user experience enhancements like visual badges for custom firms.

hallucinated_features.description: Migration module (backend/migration.mo) for handling UserProfile schema changes
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not mention any migration strategy or requirement for handling existing user data during the schema update. While this is good engineering practice, it was not explicitly requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Star icon (lucide-react Star) imported but not clearly used in the implementation
hallucinated_features.reason: The AddAccountDialog.tsx imports Star icon from lucide-react, but the diff doesn't show clear usage of this icon. REQ-116 mentions 'optional badge or icon' for custom firms, but Star was not specified.
No requirement specifies the need to clear all custom prop firms from localStorage. This function is not referenced in any acceptance criteria.
